data.raw_text:
Severe storms and monsoon rains have recently battered the Philippines, causing widespread flooding, landslides, and the displacement of communities. Hundreds of thousands have been evacuated, and more than six dozen municipalities have declared a state of calamity. Schools and transportation services have been suspended in the affected areas, including Metro Manila. Tragically, lives have also been lost.

@ifrc is working closely with @philredcross. PRC has mobilized its nationwide volunteer network to support evacuations and deliver vital humanitarian assistance.

According to the latest reports from PRC, 38,892 people have received assistance through rescue operations, health and hygiene services, and the distribution of hot meals, relief items, and clean drinking water.

#PhilippinesFloods #HumanitarianResponse #Monsoon2025 
 #CommunityResilience
